items.title: India’s billion-dollar trade juggernaut has an unwanted case of missing balance
items.summary: India’s early FTAs promised a two-way trade highway, but 15 years later the traffic looks decidedly one-sided. Deficits with ASEAN, Japan and South Korea have ballooned as imports raced ahead of exports. Trade experts say the answer is not to shut the road, but to repair it — from tariff imbalances and non-tariff barriers to poor FTA utilisation and costly inputs at home.

items.title: Sensex today | Stock Market Live: Sensex, Nifty hold firm; IT stocks under pressure, NSE IPO in focus
items.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices LIVE: Around 12 noon, Sensex was up 164.69 pts or 0.22%, trading at 74,501.14. Nifty 50 rose 91.35 pts or 0.39% to 23,308.95.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares dip below ₹716; Stock hits day low
items.summary: The stock ended at ₹721.50 on Wednesday and moderated between ₹713.10 and ₹719.05 during Thursday’s session

items.title: NMDC recovers 27.29-carat diamond at Panna site, its second-largest yet
items.summary: NMDC Panna has recovered a significant 27.29-carat gem-quality diamond. This discovery marks the second-largest diamond ever found at the Panna mine. The find follows a 13.16-carat diamond recovered earlier in July. NMDC operates India's only mechanized diamond mine in Panna, Madhya Pradesh. The company is also India's largest iron ore producer.

items.title: Micron to scale up India chip assembly multifold next year as semiconductor mission shifts to execution
items.summary: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said the company will scale up semiconductor assembly and testing at its Sanand facility multifold next year, as India’s semiconductor policy push moves from vision to execution. Speaking at SEMICON India 2026, he said the company’s India operations are supporting jobs, global memory-chip production and growing AI-driven demand.

items.title: SEMICON India 2026: India’s chip story has moved from files to factories, says PM Modi
items.summary: India's semiconductor sector is now moving towards commercial production. Prime Minister Modi inaugurated SEMICON India 2026, highlighting this significant shift. The government is encouraging more private sector investment in research and development. India aims to become a preferred global destination for chip manufacturing. Further reforms are being introduced to widen participation in the sector.

items.title: Treasury yields move lower after Fed kicks off hiking cycle
items.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.

items.title: Tech treating AI like humans is mistaken and misguided, Microsoft boss tells BBC
items.summary: Mustafa Suleyman says he believes rival AI firm Anthropic is in effect teaching Claude it "may be conscious".

items.title: Mukul Agrawal’s portfolio: Top 5 stock holdings and their one-month performance
items.summary: He publicly holds 72 stocks with a net worth of nearly Rs 7,910 crore, according to Trendlyne data.

items.title: Rentomojo shares jump 9% after listing at 19% premium over IPO price. Can the debut-day mojo last?
items.summary: Rentomojo shares surged 9% after a strong debut, taking gains to 30% above the IPO price. The stock listed at a 19% premium and rallied to Rs 526.70 within an hour. While analysts see long-term potential, they have flagged valuation concerns and advised caution after the sharp listing-day gains.

items.title: Tata Motors to hike commercial vehicle prices by up to 1% from Oct 1
items.summary: Tata Motors will increase commercial vehicle prices by up to one percent. This price revision aims to offset rising commodity and input costs. The company announced this change will take effect from October first.

items.title: A-One Steels fixes price band for Rs 405-crore IPO opening on September 24
items.summary: A-One Steels IPO has fixed its price band at Rs 385-405 per share and will open for subscription on September 24. The Rs 405 crore issue comprises a fresh issue and OFS, with proceeds primarily earmarked for repayment of outstanding borrowings.

items.title: Tata Electronics set to sign 16 MoUs at SEMICON India 2026 as ecosystem expands: CEO Randhir Thakur
items.summary: Tata Electronics is set to sign 16 MoUs at SEMICON India 2026 with domestic and international companies to strengthen India’s semiconductor supply chain.

items.title: Applied Materials announces $5 billion India investment under Vision 2035 for semiconductor ecosystem
items.summary: Applied Materials will invest five billion dollars over the next decade. This investment aims to accelerate India's semiconductor ecosystem integration globally. The company will deepen research and development capabilities within India. It also plans to accelerate the local supply chain capacity ten times. President of the Semiconductor Products Group at Applied Materials, Prabhu Raja said speaking at SEMICON India 2026.

items.title: Semicon India 2.0 targets 200 chip design startups, 1 lakh technicians, Ashwini Vaishnaw says
items.summary: Semicon India 2.0 aims to support 200 chip design startups and companies. This initiative will also develop one lakh new semiconductor technicians and industry-ready talent. The program focuses on six pillars, including chip design, equipment, fabs, and research. India has already achieved its initial engineer training target ahead of schedule. The government is now expanding its focus to technicians and factory-floor workforce development.

items.title: Juniper Hotels shares rise 2% on proposed Rs 248 crore acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa
items.summary: Juniper Hotels shares rose on Thursday after the company proposed acquiring the operating Novotel Imagicaa hotel in Maharashtra for Rs 248 crore. The 287-key property, located in Khopoli, spans around 11 acres and includes restaurants, banquet and meeting facilities. The acquisition is aimed at expanding Juniper’s presence in the Mumbai-Pune corridor.

items.title: Windfall levy on petrol, diesel and jet fuel lowered
items.summary: The SAED along with road and infrastructure cess on export of diesel is now ₹20 per litre; SAED on export of ATF is set at ₹15/litre; Duty on petrol exports has been slashed to ₹0.5 per litre

items.title: ‘Fed’ up with inflation? US rate hike leaves RBI with an October-or-December dilemma, economists say
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve’s first rate hike since 2023 has added to pressure on India, with the rupee breaching 96 against the dollar and economists increasingly debating when the RBI could follow with a hike of its own. Emkay sees an October move as increasingly likely, while HDFC Bank expects the central bank could wait until December as it weighs inflation, growth, energy prices and currency pressures.

items.title: Sensex rises 200 points, Nifty above 23,300 despite Fed rate hike. Why bears may be ready to pounce
items.summary: Sensex and Nifty extended gains despite the US Federal Reserve’s first rate hike in three years, supported by broad-based buying outside the IT sector. Analysts remain cautious as elevated bond yields, FII selling, rupee weakness and geopolitical risks could fuel volatility.

items.title: Kaynes Tech, Syrma SGS, MosChip, others rally up to 10% as PM Modi set to inaugurate Semicon 2026
items.summary: Semiconductor stocks, including Kaynes Technology, Syrma SGS Technology and MosChip Technologies, rallied up to 10% as investor attention turned to India’s semiconductor ecosystem ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s inauguration of Semicon India 2026.

items.title: Generac stock jumps 40%: What’s behind the after-hours rally?
items.summary: Generac Holdings shares surged over 40% after the company announced a long-term agreement to supply backup generators worth up to $8 billion to Amazon data centres.

items.title: Interest rates hold expected but Bank of England facing tough choices
items.summary: Forecasts of further rises in the inflation rate mean some analysts expect the Bank to act by the end of the year.

items.title: Brent Crude falls to $105 on reports of Saudi cargoes via Oman
items.summary: At 10.01 am on Thursday, November Brent oil futures were at $105.87, down by 0.04 per cent, and October crude oil futures on WTI (West Texas Intermediate) were at $102.38, down by 0.05 per cent

items.title: Global Market: BOJ rate hike bets lift short-term JGB yields to multi-decade highs
items.summary: Japanese government bond yields rose at the short end of the curve, with the 2-year yield reaching its highest level in more than three decades as investors raised bets on a Bank of Japan rate hike. Longer-dated JGB yields declined as lower oil prices eased inflation concerns.

items.title: GMR Airports shares gain 2% after JM Financial retains Buy rating; sees up to 24% upside
items.summary: GMR Airports shares witnessed an uptick on Thursday after JM Financial retained its Buy rating and Rs 115 target price, citing an improved risk-reward profile despite subdued passenger traffic. The brokerage expects traffic pressure to persist through November, but sees growth improving from December as favourable base effects and resilient international traffic support recovery.

items.title: Indian bonds dip as Fed move seen as final straw pushing RBI toward hikes
items.summary: The rising interest rates announced by the US Federal Reserve have led to a dip in Indian government bonds, adding urgency for the Reserve Bank of India to reassess its monetary policy strategies. With investor confidence dwindling ahead of the RBI's scheduled debt sale, market analysts are increasingly predicting an October rate hike, with some banks adjusting their predictions.

items.title: Hospitals seek new pricing rules as Maharashtra FDA flags high markups
items.summary: The healthcare industry seeks a differentiated framework for medical device pricing reviews. Hospitals incur significant costs beyond procurement for safe patient technology delivery. Excessive margins on routine consumables warrant scrutiny, while complex technologies need separate assessment. Maharashtra FDA flagged large gaps between trade prices and MRPs for hospital items. The center has requested a report from the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority.

items.title: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate-membership proposal
items.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

items.title: Trump plans to meet Gulf leaders at UN next week on Iran war's endgame: report
items.summary: Washington's efforts for resuming ceasefire talks appear to have stalled, as Gulf states absorb escalating attacks from Iran and Iran-aligned Houthi militants.

items.title: Top SME IPOs gave up to 435% returns this year. How many are in your portfolio?
items.summary: From strong post-listing rallies to sharp gains in the months since their debut, these stocks have emerged as standout performers in the SME segment.

items.title: $46 billion IPO: NSE is the world’s most expensive stock exchange. Can it also become the most valuable?
items.summary: NSE’s Rs 22,569-crore IPO has opened for subscription, valuing India’s largest stock exchange at nearly $46 billion at the upper price band. At 42.9 times FY26 earnings, NSE commands a higher valuation multiple than most major global exchanges, including Nasdaq, CME Group, ICE, HKEX and LSEG. Analysts attribute the premium to NSE’s profitability, market dominance and India’s long-term capital market opportunity.

items.title: Why investors are turning bullish on Snap stock
items.summary: Snap shares gained in after-hours trading after the company unveiled Specs Intelligence AI and showcased its augmented-reality glasses. The company also announced enterprise partnerships with Salesforce, Nvidia and AWS, while pricing Specs at $2,195.

items.title: Global Market: Nikkei gains as investors snap up gaming, pharma stocks
items.summary: Japan’s Nikkei edged higher as investors bought beaten-down gaming and pharmaceutical shares, while falling crude oil prices supported sentiment. Gains remained limited as chip stocks fell and investors awaited the Bank of Japan’s policy decision.

items.title: 6 mainboard IPOs make market debut: Rentomojo, Karamtara Engineering, LCC Projects list at strong premiums
items.summary: Investors welcomed the new listings with enthusiasm, as LCC Projects led the pack with a notable 31.4% premium, while Rentomojo and Karamtara Engineering also showcased strong performances, signalling a robust appetite for IPOs despite mixed results from other debuts.

items.title: Krsnaa Diagnostics shares surge 11% after securing 15-Year Punjab PET-CT Deal
items.summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics shares surged after the company signed a 15-year concession agreement with Punjab Health Systems Corporation. The pact marks its entry into PET-CT diagnostics, with the company set to develop and operate facilities at four government hospitals in Punjab under a PPP model.

items.title: NSE IPO: IFCI, New India Assurance, other stocks rally up to 9% as Rs 22,569 crore IPO opens. How much exposure do they have?
items.summary: IFCI, New India Assurance and other stocks rallied after the Rs 22,569 crore NSE IPO opened for subscription. The companies have direct or indirect exposure to NSE, with several shareholders also selling stakes through the offer-for-sale. NSE’s IPO comprises 12.64 crore shares and is open for bidding until September 21.

items.title: Bank of England set to defy Fed’s rate-hike lead, despite rising inflation
items.summary: The Bank of England is expected to keep rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs keep pressure on prices.

items.title: From phones to fabs: India is building its semiconductor muscle
items.summary: India's semiconductor strategy is widening from fabs to a complete ecosystem. The nation is building capabilities across design, packaging, and manufacturing. Significant government investment supports this comprehensive semiconductor value chain development. This push aligns with a growing electronics manufacturing base and global supply chain shifts. The focus is on connecting all pieces to become a durable global participant.

items.title: Highway Infrastructure shares jump 5% after securing Rs 220 crore order from UPEIDA
items.summary: Highway Infrastructure shares rose nearly 5% to Rs 45.90 after the company secured a Rs 220.66 crore contract from UPEIDA for toll collection and plaza operations on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway. The two-year order includes annual escalation. The company also recently secured an Rs 80.16 crore Tamil Nadu toll plaza project.

items.title: Inside India newsletter: The world’s largest real-time payments system will no longer be free for all
items.summary: India's digital payment system, which processes more than 1 million transactions every two minutes for free now, will start charging fees to merchants.

items.title: Gold rises as investors digest Fed hike, oil rally stalls
items.summary: Spot metal at $4,295.26; Warsh joins unanimous Fed decision flagging more tightening this year

items.summary: NSE allotted shares worth $703.04 million to marquee global ‌and domestic investors, including the ​sovereign wealth funds of Norway and Abu ⁠Dhabi, as part of its ⁠anchor book allocation ahead of the ‌issue

items.title: Glass Wall Systems shares rally 32% in 2 days after IPO. What should investors do?
items.summary: Glass Wall Systems shares rallied 12% on Thursday, extending gains after a 7% premium listing and an 18% rise on debut. Analysts highlighted project execution, earnings growth, margins and cash-flow generation as key factors to watch.

items.title: A stronger dollar and rising yields: How the Fed’s rate hike could hit global markets
items.summary: Higher U.S. rates could also keep global bond yields elevated and weigh on equity valuations and economic growth.

items.title: US Market: Fed's Warsh points to AI investment, geopolitical risks for higher yields
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said rising bond yields reflect economic strength, heavy capital investment in AI and data centers, and geopolitical uncertainty rather than persistent inflation concerns or doubts about the Fed’s credibility. He emphasized that financial markets inform policymakers but do not dictate decisions, following the Fed’s recent 25-basis-point rate hike.

items.title: Putin braces for election stress test as Russians ‘feel the pain’ of struggling economy
items.summary: Russia’s upcoming election is expected to cement United Russia’s dominance, but voter turnout and its margin of victory could offer clues to public discontent.

items.title: Rupee slips below 96 per dollar level in early trade
items.summary: In a significant market shift, the rupee has dipped to 96 against the US dollar, marking a low not seen in over two months. This decline is attributed to a combination of weak investor confidence and ongoing global economic uncertainties. Challenges from elevated crude oil prices and a strengthening dollar were intensified by the Federal Reserve's latest interest rate increase.

items.title: Asian LNG demand set to fall for second year as war shrinks supply
items.summary: Asia's LNG ​demand, which already fell in 2025, was expected to recover by 4-7% this year on lower prices fuelled by rising U.S. and Qatari supplies

items.title: US Fed Rate Hike: What it means for your money and investments
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve’s quarter-point rate hike could raise borrowing costs for credit card and adjustable-rate mortgage borrowers while benefiting savers and new bond investors. Here’s how the latest Fed move could affect household finances.

items.title: LNG gets too hot for Asia at $26, but India keeps buying
items.summary: Asian LNG demand is projected to decrease this year, with Northeast Asia seeing the largest drop. India and Bangladesh continue to secure spot LNG cargoes despite significant price increases. High fuel costs are impacting energy-intensive industries in China, reducing their output. India's city gas and fertilizer sectors will predominantly support its LNG demand. Global supply recovery and Europe's inventory needs will influence future LNG prices.

items.title: LCC Projects makes strong D-Street debut, listing at 31% premium over IPO price
items.summary: LCC Projects made a strong stock-market debut after its Rs 427.14 crore IPO. The shares listed at Rs 191.90 on the NSE, a 31.44% premium, and at Rs 189 on the BSE, a 29.45% premium over the issue price of Rs 146.

items.title: Asset Reconstruction Company shares list flat at Rs 139 on BSE, NSE
items.summary: On Thursday, shares of Asset Reconstruction Company India Ltd. debuted with little movement following a notable initial public offering valued at Rs 732.97 crore, consisting entirely of an offer for sale. Priced at Rs 139 per share, the offer attracted significant demand, seeing an impressive twenty-fold subscription. Notably, the proceeds will benefit the selling shareholders, rather than the company itself.

items.title: India vows to protect energy security as US Russia bill opens door to 100% tariffs
items.summary: India is closely watching a US bill that could allow tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian energy. With Russia accounting for 30.3% of India’s crude imports in FY2026, New Delhi said it would prioritise energy security, diversify supplies and protect its trade and economic interests.

items.title: SS Retail IPO Day 2; GMP at 19%, subscribed 1.44 times; Check key details
items.summary: SS Retail’s Rs 500 crore IPO entered its second day after being subscribed 1.44 times on Day 1, led by strong retail demand. The issue’s current GMP indicates a potential listing gain of around 19%.

items.title: Health Ministry issues advisory clamping down on unregulated use of stem cell therapies
items.summary: The Union Health Ministry has tightened oversight of stem cell therapies, warning against their unregulated use and making clear that they can be offered as standard treatment only for Ministry-approved conditions.

items.title: Gold prices fall Rs 2,000/10 gram, silver dips Rs 4,600/kg as US Fed hikes rate after 3 years. Time to sell?
items.summary: Gold and silver prices fell sharply on the MCX on Thursday after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signalled further tightening. Easing oil supply concerns also weighed on bullion sentiment, as higher rates make non-yielding assets less attractive.

Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions lists at 2% discount to IPO price
items.summary: Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions made a weak stock market debut after its Rs 805-crore IPO was subscribed 1.26 times overall. The shares opened at a discount to the issue price on both the BSE and NSE. The IPO comprised a fresh issue and an offer for sale, with proceeds earmarked primarily for capital expenditure across the company’s manufacturing facilities.

items.title: US Market: Goldman Sachs sees Fed raising rates again in October
items.summary: Goldman Sachs now expects the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by another 25 basis points in October, revising its earlier view that the central bank had completed its tightening cycle after a September rate increase.

HDFC Bank is winning the mutual fund vote over ICICI Bank. Can the shift last?
items.summary: HDFC Bank’s stock has fallen 27% in 2026, while ICICI Bank has gained 1.6%. Yet mutual funds have increasingly favoured HDFC Bank, adding to the laggard while trimming ICICI Bank. By August-end, ICICI Bank remained the larger mutual-fund holding, but the recent flow pattern signals a shift in preference as investors assess HDFC Bank’s valuation and recovery potential.

items.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Indian equity markets ended higher on Wednesday, tracking gains across regional markets, as expectations surrounding the US Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision supported sentiment. Buying interest in banking, FMCG and automobile stocks lifted large-cap shares, while IT stocks declined.

items.title: Mark Walter and Todd Boehly selling stakes in Chelsea Football Club to Clearlake Capital
items.summary: Two of Walter's insurance companies faces federal criminal and civil investigations into the accounting of roughly $21 billion in financial transactions.

items.title: Russian oil uncertainty hangs over India’s largest buyers
items.summary: Indian state-owned refiners are facing growing crude supply uncertainty as Middle East disruptions coincide with the risk of tougher US restrictions on Russian oil buyers. Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline shutdown has disrupted more than 400,000 barrels a day of supplies to India, although about half the capacity could return within days.

items.title: The rise of the wedding entrepreneur: How India’s celebrations are creating new creative businesses
items.summary: India's wedding industry is undergoing a remarkable transformation, evolving into a diverse and complex sector that goes beyond traditional offerings. A new wave of specialized entrepreneurs is emerging to meet the demand for customized, multi-day events, requiring varied expertise and coordination. Destination weddings are expanding opportunities for countless service providers, and with India's rich creative resources, the nation is set to influence the luxury wedding market worldwide.

items.title: Japan’s corporate leaders sound alarm over weak yen — even dollar-earners are voicing concerns
items.summary: While the Japanese yen has strengthened rapidly over the past two weeks, it remains weak in historical terms.

items.title: OpenAI reveals six more safety issues and unveils plan to disclose incidents
items.summary: The firm also announced a new system to track, investigate and disclose cases of models misbehaving, or "misalignment".

items.summary: The rupee is expected ⁠to open slightly weaker around 96-96.05 per dollar, down from its previous close of 95.9550

items.title: India’s Semicon 2.0 should go beyond chip fabs, focus on design, packaging: Chris Miller
items.summary: India's semiconductor strategy should broaden beyond fabrication to include design and equipment. Advanced packaging offers another significant area for India to build capabilities. Deep integration into global value chains is essential for any successful strategy. This approach combines existing design talent with manufacturing and packaging investments. India can strengthen its global semiconductor position by developing specialized capabilities.

items.title: Can wearable tech ease period pain? Curapod launches new device
items.summary: Curapod has launched a new wearable device for menstrual pain management. This device utilizes red and near-infrared light wavelengths for pain relief. The wearable connects to a mobile application for personalized light dosage adjustments. Clinical evaluations indicate significant pain reduction for many users. The company is expanding its wearable technology into other pain management areas.

items.summary: Oil prices fell as additional Saudi crude supplies eased concerns over disruptions to the kingdom’s exports.

items.title: India supplies Wall Street with CEOs but has a shortage at home
items.summary: India’s biggest private banks are finding it increasingly difficult to identify executives with the breadth of experience needed to lead large, complex institutions. HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank’s CEO searches have highlighted a surprisingly narrow talent pool, as regulatory requirements, limited succession pipelines and competing financial sectors constrain potential candidates.
